identification: Photo: cardboard box holding a black Xbox One (original, with power brick, no controller seen), a grey SNES-style console with two controller ports (PAL SNES shape), a cream/grey rounded unit (possibly a Super Famicom or other retro console, unconfirmed), a yellow Game Boy-style handheld-like LCD game toy (not a real Game Boy; looks like a yellow electronic toy), a microphone, an XtremeMac iPod/iPad dock (boxed, probably low value) and a teal boxed item (maybe a games/tricks book or accessory). All untested, no controllers, no games visible.

chrome_hint: eBay sold, Australia: 'Super Nintendo PAL console only untested' and 'Xbox One console only' if the SNES is confirmed genuine.
viewing_check: Check the grey unit: is it a real PAL SNES (SUPER NINTENDO label, model SNS-001/101) or a clone, and is it yellowed or cracked. Identify the cream unit (label on underside) and the teal boxed item. Look for controllers or leads under the Xbox One. Check the Xbox One model, serial and whether the power brick is original.
